title: Microsoft Teams: user setting to stop presence switching to Do not disturb while screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts and documented call-handling behaviour match the sources, and the changed Q&A page still gives the quoted user setting. Searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps; one checklist sentence should distinguish this presenting opt-out from other presence controls.
